skill.summary: Автоматический сбор и анализ данных о конкурентах в робототехнике из Google и базы знаний с выводом рейтинга, цен и адресов.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of competitor-parser skill.

- Added automated collection and analysis of competitors in robotics.
- Supports data aggregation from Google Search, Яндекс.Карты, 2ГИС, VK, and internal sources.
- Provides summary, pricing, and location analytics based on parsed data.
- Outputs results in both JSON and CSV formats.
- Includes command-line instructions and Telegram integration for report delivery.
- Known limitations: Restricted access to Яндекс.Карты, 2ГИС, and VK without additional setup.
